description: This file defines the class JsonObjectAssert, which provides a set of assertion methods for verifying properties and contents of JsonObject instances within testing contexts. It extends assertj's AbstractIterableAssert and offers customized assertions for JSON objects, such as size, containment of keys/values, and structural type checks.

classes.name: JsonObjectAssert
classes.description: A specialized assertion class for JsonObject instances, providing methods to verify size, contents, structure, and specific property conditions in test assertions.

methods.name: hasSize
methods.description: Checks if the JsonObject has the specified size.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonObject contains a specific key-value pair, with multiple overloads for different value types.

methods.name: doesNotContain
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonObject does not contain a specified key or field definition.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if the JsonObject is equal to an expected set of JsonFields.

methods.name: isEqualToIgnoringFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Compares two JsonObjects for equality, ignoring field definitions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Overloads of methods verifying presence of a field denoted by a JsonPointer or JsonFieldDefinition with an expected value.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON object contains specified keys.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is an array.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not an array.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is an object.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not an object.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is a boolean.

methods.name: isNotBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNullLiteral
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is a null literal.

methods.name: isNotNullLiteral
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not a null literal.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is a number.

methods.name: isNotNumber
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not a number.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is a string.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue is not a string.

methods.name: doesNotSupport
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonValue does not support a specific consumer operation.
